scripts.dev: npm run db:seed && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w apps/api && npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w apps/web
